name: clorraine
description: Clorraine language support: compiler diagnostics, hover, definition, completion, and symbols.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode Clorraine does not start the language server, look for tools, save files, or run tasks.

clorraine.lsp.path.description: Language server executable (clorraine-lsp, or clorraine-lsp.exe on Windows). Empty searches CLORRAINE_LSP, the installed CLI (~/.local/bin on Linux, %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Clorraine\current\bin on Windows), trusted development builds, and PATH.

clorraine.driver.path.description: Clorraine driver executable (clorraine, or clorraine.exe on Windows). Empty searches the installed CLI (~/.local/bin on Linux, %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Clorraine\current\bin on Windows), trusted development builds, and PATH.

clorraine.toolchain.path.description: Upstream Amiga toolchain root containing bin/m68k-amigaos-gcc. Empty uses CLORRAINE_TOOLCHAIN or the CLI config. The old clorraine.sdk.path is read once with a warning.

clorraine.fsUae.path.description: FS-UAE executable (fs-uae, or fs-uae.exe on Windows) used by Run in FS-UAE.

clorraine.kickstart.path.description: Locally licensed Kickstart ROM used by Run in FS-UAE.

clorraine.profile.description: Compiler profile shared by diagnostics, navigation and Build/Run actions.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run stage && node --test test/*.test.ts
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run stage
